title.narrative: Integrated Environmental Management and Climate Resilience Project (IEMCRP)

description.narrative: The Programme aims to support The Gambia on strategic programmatic interventions in Climate Resilience (mitigation and adaptation), Disaster Risk Management, Renewable Energy Access, Natural Resource Management and Sustainable Chemicals and Waste Management. This will contribute to the attainment of Sustainable Development Goals 7, 13, 15 and 17. The Programme will also reduce the vulnerability of communities and natural systems to climate change through sustainable natural resource and Disaster Risk management practices and implementation of clean energy solutions and sustainable waste management initiatives. In alignment with signature solutions 3, 4, 5, 6, Sustainable Development Goals 7, 13, 15, 17 and the Long-Term Vision, UNDP interventions will focus on climate resilience, disaster risk management, renewable energy, sustainable chemicals and waste management, and sustainable natural resource management for biodiversity and functional ecosystems, with a focus on land, rivers, and oceans.
